name: La Luisiana (Spain)
description: White field with a light blue band from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a green band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Luisiana (the arms of Castile and León and fleurs-de-lis).
history: Municipal flag of La Luisiana; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
